title: Good Habits Paragraph
titleMy: ကောင်းသည့် အလေ့အကျင့် စာပိုဒ်

exercises.instruction: Good habits start with small steps. If you read a little every day, you will read many books in a year. If you practice typing daily, your speed and accuracy will grow quickly. Keep going and never give up.
